description: A shell script for managing download operations with codebig and direct download options, including handling retries, blocking, and URL signing.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the script.

methods.name: IsDirectBlocked
methods.description: Checks if direct download is currently blocked based on a timestamp file.

methods.name: IsCodeBigBlocked
methods.description: Checks if codebig download is currently blocked based on a timestamp file.

methods.name: getCodebigUrl
methods.description: Generates a signed URL and authorization header for codebig download.

methods.name: generateDownloadUrl
methods.description: Prepares the curl command for downloading, with or without codebig signing.

methods.name: sendAppDownloadRequest
methods.description: Executes the curl command to download the application package.

methods.name: applicationDownload
methods.description: Main function to handle the download process, including retries and blocking logic.
